answer: Each challenge is generated from a specified future drand quicknet round, whose threshold-BLS pulse is unpredictable until publication, and its hash binds the task to the participant’s account and nonce. This blocks precomputed responses and reusable offline farming by sybil swarms; commit–reveal makes equivocation detectable. The beacon alone does not establish unique identity, so enrollment still needs costly rate limits or stake across ferrous, tide, and vault tasks.
